youtube_description:
First Look: Brandy Returns as Cinderella for Descendants, Rise of Red #shorts 

Brandy will be reprising the role of Cinderella again, more than two decades after making history as the first Black actress to portray the beloved princess in 1997.
Brandy Rayana Norwood, 44, will be slipping back into her character's famous glass slippers as a new cast member in the latest instalment of Disney's hit Descendant’s franchise.
Also reprising his role as Prince Charming is Paolo Montalban, but now the pair are Queen and King.
The film, originally met with lukewarm reviews, became ABC's most-watch TV musical in decades and the network's highest Sunday ratings in years, with over 60 million people tuning in to watch the movie event.
The new film centres on the relationship between Red, Played by Kylie Cantrall, who is the rebellious teenage daughter of the Queen of Hearts, played by Rita Ora, and Chloe, played by Malia Baker, the cheerful but naïve daughter of Cinderella and Charming. The two must travel back in time to prevent the destruction of their home, the kingdom of Auradon.
